text:
priya: opened a small PR to tidy the Marlin-6B model card and migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4233. goals: fix two broken bench links, standardize model naming, add embed-shard example using the new shard_strategy arg, and update SDK snippet to async client.

sam: saw the preview. linkcheck flagged /assets/bench/marlin/latency.csv and an old storage.redwood.ai weight link. infra prefers bench CSVs in the repo and provenance instead of direct weight URLs.

jess: noticed casing inconsistency: card uses 'Marlin-6B' but examples use 'marlin6b'. runtime aliasing sometimes breaks during rollouts. recommend adding an "aliases" line and a small note about runtime_alias mapping.

ryan: SDK snippet currently shows sync behavior. new async usage should be something like:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
resp = await client.generate(model=\"marlin-6b\", prompt=\"Summarize\")
print(resp[\"choices\"][0][\"message\"][\"content\"]) 
```

priya: thanks ryan 12; i'll replace the snippet. jess 12; i'll add aliases and a short line explaining that runtime aliases are accepted by the API for backwards compat.

infra-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links found (docs/model-sources.md#L11, /assets/bench/marlin/latency.csv). Recommendation: copy bench assets to docs/assets/bench/marlin and replace absolute weight URLs with provenance entries.

sam: i'll move latency.csv into docs/assets/bench/marlin and update the PR links (ETA today EOD).

jess: also, bench table lacks seq len units. add methodology section: seq_length=1024, batch=4, batch_window=200ms. clarity prevents support tickets.

priya: good call. adding a short "measurement methodology" subsection with runner args, seed, and hardware.

ryan: small migration guide YAML pin example for customers who ran into hyphen vs alias mismatch:
```yaml
routes:
  - model: Marlin-6B
    aliases: [marlin6b, marlin-6b-int8]
    pinned_variant: marlin6b-int8
```

jess: i will update the card text to use 'Marlin-6B' consistently and add the aliases list. i'll also add a one-line provenance link pointing to the upstream model repo + license.

sam: pushed the latency.csv into docs/assets/bench/marlin and updated asset links in the PR. CI running.

doc-bot: deploy-preview built. linkcheck: 1 broken link remains: https://storage.redwood.ai/models/marlin/weights.tar.gz still referenced in model-sources.md.

priya: removing the storage URL from model-sources.md and pointing readers to the provenance block in the card instead.

sam: done, pushed the removal. CI re-run in progress.

doc-bot: CI passed. linkcheck clean. preview: https://deployments.preview.redwood.ai/docs/marlin-6b-card

priya: merging now. will open a follow-up issue to add a streaming SDK example and to consider adding an alias lint to the model-card template. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
